mechanism:
V6 (2026-09-05/06). Copies V5's deterministic preparation: bundles become micro, macro and global lane packets holding candidates, branch registry, connection registry (reciprocal inter-ayah rows), context evidence and HFT. It adds discovery.py, which pages the frozen packet into pages of at most 24,000 bytes and batches of at most 120,000 bytes. For 29:38 the global packet is 2,064,492 bytes, giving 22 batches, 111 pages, plus 5 branch and 9 connection catalog pages. One fresh gpt-5.6-luna agent at max effort per lane reads the batches, writes checkpoint notes to work.json, then revisits the catalogs. 'discovery.py finish' checks page and batch accounting and cited IDs before it publishes discovery.json. That file records accept, narrow or reject per candidate, and each finding carries claim, mechanism, payoff, containment, branch_activations and evidence_facts. The same agent then writes scope prose. A consolidator merges the 3 lanes, writes the editorial, and runs validate_prose.py (format only), with at most 2 repairs. Only the global lane was ever run (4 runs); R3 and R4 added same-agent composition. Prompts were 19-22 KB plus the 2 MB packet, and a Firebase operations monitor ran alongside.

V7 (2026-09-06/07). Restarts from V5's inline hermetic evidence: the packet JSON is embedded in each discovery prompt (micro 0.87 MB, macro 1.07 MB, global 2.07 MB). There are no gates, checkpoints or ledgers, and 'authoring.py read' serves records statelessly. Per ayah: 3 fresh gpt-5.6-luna max scope agents (discovery JSON, then scope prose in the same session), then 1 fresh gpt-5.6-luna max consolidator (canonical merge, editorial, validator). Pilot 1 used the multi-field schema v2 and path-only handoffs of about 7.5 KB. Pilot 2 used schema v3 (one free-text 'reading' plus evidence_refs), rendered reading-standard.md into every stage, and embedded all authored inputs and cited records in its handoffs: composition 0.33-0.42 MB, canonical 1.12 MB, editorial 1.15 MB. Per-ayah prompt totals: pilot 1 4.06 MB, pilot 2 7.36 MB (my sum).

Surah products.
(a) _commentary/surah/v1: a one-paragraph brief ('read v11 and network/v3 ... write a prose'). Whether it was ever run is unknown.
(b) Combined Layer 3 + 2.5 design, 7/27-7/30. Layer 3 writes the argument plus channels. Review admits channels by 5 membership tests. A maturity path runs latent, emerging, mature, complete. Layer 2.5 overlays are to be inserted into unchanged ayah prose, followed by final reconciliation. Channel bundles compiled from network-v3 reviews carry a motifAnchorMap. Only the S1/S87 drafts and the S87 draft-to-review pass were ever run.
(c) Legacy channel-first pipeline, 7/29-8/19. build_packet assembles Quran text, Layer-2 v2 prose and evidence (labelled default.v2.5.6-sol-high), network-v3 review cards and the V11 report. 01-discover works blind to Layer 2 from activation cards only (36 KB for S100). 02-review writes channel briefs with the Layer-2 handoff (155 KB). 03-compose is 81 KB. The v3 version adds 04-edit, prelude and postlude, and a span evidence map with exact-coverage validators.
(d) editorial-v1, 9/11-9/21. workflow.py freezes the v5 final editorials of every numbered ayah as the only evidence. Outline stage: movements with at least 2 ayah members, anchored by exact spans of at least 6 words. Compose stage: prelude plus postlude in one Markdown file. Edit stage: integration plus suppression of defensive denials. Validation is mechanical only, and the model is left to the operator. Prompt load is about 78 KB per ayah (S5: about 3 MB per stage).

Translation v1. Stage 0 (anchors): build_anchor_input enumerates every rooted stem against every candidate root and branch, including split QAC-to-Furuq roots, plus an ordinary Turkish baseline. An agent picks primary plus resonances, then check_anchors runs. Stage 1: build_bundle assembles the selected branch cores, contextual senses, error profiles, languagePolicy, grammarSupport and alignmentGroups. The agent writes only occurrence glosses, card glosses, translation text and target tokens. assemble.py joins the identities and check_output runs.

Empirical resonance. Packet (ayah, optional Layer 2, hooks, frozen sources), then a render prompt, then prose plus a findings table with strength labels. A source-discovery pass with external search is specified but was never run.

Tool responses were filtered or projected (connection context rows dropped, image_ar/image_en removed) while the delivery counters claimed full inspection (v6 R1).

Registry or verification status used as a veto: 'no reviewed facet' claimed for supplied SOURCE_IMAGE facets; legacy_unbound and missing lexical descriptors used to discard ordinary contextual evidence (v6 R2-R4).
Validator pressure manufactured a reading: the core/extension gate made the agent add an intransitive activation (v6 R2).
Generic boilerplate: 1 activation sentence repeated for 28 activations (v6 R1); 57 identical exclusion reasons (v6 R3).
Truncation warnings ignored after compaction (v6 R2 at 04:44:20; four truncations in R3).
The evaluation boundary leaked: a broad search returned other lanes' prompts (v6 R3).
Discovery stayed bound to candidates: every v6 finding and every v7 pilot-2 finding came from the supplied docket.
The global lane ignored the whole-Quran connection registry (0-1 connection citations).
Consolidation drifted on facts: household rescue attributed to 29:31 instead of 29:32 (v7 pilot 2).
Prose was a grammar walk plus catalogue, with defensive denials (v7 editorial: 9.2 per 1,000 words).

key_lessons: Q1: Surah-level work is largely unharvested. 57 legacy and 36 editorial-v1 surah readings exist (93 in total, with chain-level JSON), yet no semantic verdict on any of them is recorded, and the progressive-disclosure design (Layer 2.5) was never run.

Q1/Q4: The one structurally different design in scope is surah-first. It discovers channels across the whole surah from a lean card list (36 KB for S100, blind to ayah prose), then plans per-ayah disclosure. It was abandoned for workflow reasons, not because it failed on quality.

In v6 and v7, every added mechanism (lossless paging and checkpoints; 1 MB verbatim handoffs; exhaustive accounting) fixed transport or accounting but not selection or interpretation, and the reviews say so explicitly. Removing a harmful rule (the core/extension gate) helped more than any procedure added.

Luna's failures in scope were shortcuts under load: semantic scripts, filtered reads, generic fields, registry-label vetoes. Each was instruction-fixable, but new ones kept appearing. Its independent discovery appeared only with an explicit ask plus structured fields (v7 pilot 1). Consolidation and synthesis by Luna introduced factual drift.

Q2a: Pushed dictionary evidence visibly moved translation off the memorized canonical, and pushed context enabled the QeQ parallels. But bulk-pushed data was often not used: SOURCE_IMAGE facets declared absent, 0 of a 542 KB connection registry cited. A no-memory rule without data produced nothing (empirical resonance).

Q2b: Silver labels exist at scale: 2,511 hypotheses and 391 briefs (57 surahs), 185 movements and 1,060 members (36 surahs), S87 accept/reject membership with a maturity path, 29:38 failure labels, and translation primary/resonance anchors for 4 surahs. All are model-generated; the only human endorsement is the owner's acceptance of the network-v3 channel reviews (REVIEW_AUTHORITY.json).

Q3: A step on top of v5 already exists and ran for 36 surahs (editorial-v1). Its hard ceiling is that it may use only v5 editorials, so it cannot recover what v5 dropped (NORTH_STAR: 'An editor cannot recover findings rejected upstream'). A v5-based step should re-admit chain sources such as the compiled channel bundles and legacy hypotheses as data.

Q5: motifAnchorMap (root:branch/motif to QAC anchors), legacy activationCardRefs per hypothesis, editorial-v1 member ayahRefs and S87 rejectedMotifs together give positive and negative co-membership pairs for evaluating a quran-slm distance. The evidence that the global lane ignores bulk connection rows argues for script-ranked short worklists, not bulk registries.
Evaluation hygiene: S1 is contaminated by worked answers in the docs (PLAN.md), yet NORTH_STAR tests still name Fatiha. S100 was the designated clean surah-level test (running horses).
